summary: In run-20260815T021145Z-0-udoZs5, the operator granted allow-once for implement-cli-bootstrap attempt 1 (op-implement-cli-bootstrap-1), which was consumed to start attempt 2, but attempt 2 immediately generated a second, unrelated fresh operator-permission request (op-implement-cli-bootstrap-2) with the same generic reason, requiring the operator to grant allow-once again for the same node in the same run.

operatorImpact: allow-run and allow-always exist as choices precisely to avoid re-prompting for the same node, but the retry after an allow-once continuation still lands back on operator-permission with a fresh request id and no memory of the prior grant, so the operator answers what looks like the same question twice for one node in roughly 26 minutes.
